name: Tamari
siboNotes: Tamari is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated by most SIBO patients. Use in moderation due to high sodium content.
preparationTips: Check labels to ensure it's 100% soy-based with no wheat additives
Store in refrigerator after opening to maintain quality
Use sparingly as it's quite salty and flavorful
Mix with rice vinegar and sesame oil for a simple low-FODMAP dressing
nutritionalHighlights: Contains umami compounds for savory flavor
